name: Elephant sanctuary

seo.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
seo.metaDescription: Ethical elephant sanctuary on Koh Lanta: walk with the elephants, feed them, mud bath, no riding. Transfer included. Adults from 1,800 THB.

draft.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta – No Riding
draft.h1: Ethical elephant sanctuary on Koh Lanta

lead: Walk with the elephants, feed them, join them in the mud bath and the pool. No riding. Three programmes, from an hour and a half to a full day.
promise: Feed and bathe the elephants, no riding

facts.label: Duration
facts.value: About 1 hr 30 min to a full day

options.label: Programme C, full day
options.note: Two people at most, booked ahead.

steps.label: A
steps.text: About 1 hr 30 min to 2 hours: walk with the elephants, feeding, mud bath, bathing together in the pool. Fresh fruit and water for you, bananas for them.

steps.label: B
steps.text: About 3 hours, at 07:30 or 13:00: everything in A, plus making traditional herbal remedies and paper from elephant dung, which you take home. Coffee and tea.

steps.label: C
steps.text: Full day from 07:30: everything in B, plus a Thai set lunch, a swim at the Emerald Pool and the hot spring waterfall. Two people per session at most, booked ahead.

included: Programme C: lunch and the entrance fees

bring: Clothes that can get dirty and wet
beforeYouBook.pickup: Hotel transfer both ways. Sessions start at 07:30, 10:00 and 13:00.

faq.a: No. You walk with the elephants, feed them and wash them. Nobody sits on them.
From an hour and a half for Programme A to a full day for Programme C, plus the transfer from your hotel.

faq.q: Is it suitable for small children?
faq.a: Yes. Children from 4 pay a child rate and under 4 go free. They stay next to you the whole time.

legacyText.title: Ethical Elephant Sanctuary Koh Lanta | Secret Travel
intro: The sanctuary is on Koh Lanta. There is no riding and no show. You spend the time next to the animals, feeding them bananas, walking with them and washing them.
Sessions start at 7:30, 10:00 and 13:00. Come in clothes that can get dirty and wet, with a towel and flip-flops.
legacyText.cardDescription: Feeding and walking with the elephants, no riding.
goodToKnow: Children from 4 to 10 pay a child rate. Under 4 go free.
Programme C takes two people per session only. Book it early.
You will get muddy. Bring a change of clothes.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. Children under 4 go free.
legacyText.caption: No riding
